caption: Distribution of Quantifiers and Operations in Categorical, Approximate Number Generation, Disjunctive Reasoning, and Conjunctive Reasoning.
model_annotation: The figure contains three separate pie charts summarizing the distribution of quantifiers and logical operations across different reasoning types: “Categorical,” “Approximate Number Generation,” and “Disjunctive & Conjunctive.” The Categorical chart has four slices with percentage labels inside: “Universal Quantifiers” in very light blue at about 29.07%, “Limiter” in light pink at about 27.91%, “Negation” in light orange at about 27.91%, and “Existential Quantifiers” in light green at about 15.12%. The Approximate Number Generation chart has three slices with internal percentage labels: “Approximate Quantities” in pale yellow at about 45.03%, “Comparative Relationships” in light blue at about 36.26%, and “Absolute Absence” in light lavender at about 18.71%. The Disjunctive & Conjunctive chart has two nearly equal slices with internal labels: “Conjunctive” in light mauve at about 50.49% and “Disjunctive” in very light bluish-gray at about 49.51%. No separate legend is shown, and none of the slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized; labels and percentages are placed directly within the wedges, and the slices appear arranged as contiguous segments without an explicitly indicated ordering scheme.
